# Pacer

> Pacer splits a salary into an initial bridge payment plus recurring
> weekly (or custom-interval) allowances, so you can see exactly how a
> lump sum stretches across a pay period.

## Pages

- [Pacer](https://pacer.timothybrits.co.za/): Enter a pay date, a last
  day, and a total amount to get a day-by-day payout schedule, with
  calendar export, CSV export, and a shareable link.
